decisions.statement: The items every rule reaches are worked out before the capacity filter.
The capacity filter runs before the plan is built.
The checklist names character logins and venue stops.
A checklist's venue stops sit under the character login they belong to.
The checklist names no single item.
The unmapped report names the items reaching the end of the rules with no rule acting on them.
The rules end in every trailing rule reaching every item and acting on none.
A rule the matcher ends with and one Alan ends with end the rules alike.
No rule a condition narrows ends the rules, whatever that rule's action.
The unmapped report gathers items by the item they are rather than by the stack.
The unmapped report is what JSON answers where JSON is asked for beside it.
A run finding no unmapped item says every item the holdings hold is reached by a rule.
The holdings are read from a stored reading rather than from the workstation.
An item a rule could not decide is told apart from an item no rule reaches.
An item is left undecided where a rule reaching it before the rule taking it could not be decided.
An item left undecided is named with every signal the rules were missing over that item.
A run finding no undecided item says no item a rule reaches is left undecided.

definition: the command working out the management plan the addon would carry out
